response.original_title: ((FAQS Cabin))- How do i add another cabin on a Princess Cruise?
response.overview: To add another Cabin to an existing Princess Cruise +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) reservation you need to book a separate stateCabin reservation +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) and ask Princess or your travel advisor to link the bookings together. Contact Your Travel Agent +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada). If you booked through a travel agency or third-party site, have your agent +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) make the new reservation for you. You cannot add a second cabin directly to an existing reservation on the Princess website or mobile app. Instead, +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) you must book a separate second stateroom and then cross-reference or link the two bookings. Go online or contact an agent to make a completely separate booking for the new cabin.
